title: A Slice of Heaven in WaterColor Vacation Rental
h1: A Slice of Heaven in WaterColor
meta_description: A Slice of Heaven in WaterColor is a 7.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Tucked away in the heart of WaterColor, A Slice of Heaven at 90 Flatwood Street combines Southern charm with refined coastal luxury for an unforgettable retreat. This three-story, 4,084-square-foot home is thoughtfully designed to host families and groups, offering five elegant bedroom suites and two bunk rooms for a comfortable and elevated stay along Scenic 30A.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with up to 12 Passes Included Private Pool (Complimentary Heating Available October 1 – May 1) 6 Adult Cruiser Bikes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Parking for 2 Vehicles Exterior Shower Outdoor Summer Kitchen with Built-In Gas Grill Washer and Dryer on Both 1st and 2nd Floors Freestanding Ice Maker and Mini Fridge on 1st Floor Screened Porch with Outdoor Dining Overlooking the Pool 4-Minute Walk to WaterColor Frog Pool 4-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club via Western Lake Bridge 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Upon entering, guests are welcomed into an open-concept layout filled with natural light and warmth. The gourmet kitchen features custom Thermador appliances, a large island, and rich oak flooring. The seamless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living areas creates an inviting environment for gathering and dining together. The home’s outdoor living spaces are equally impressive. Spacious porches overlook the private pool, while the summer kitchen invites casual grilling and relaxed afternoons. On the second floor, three king suites offer serene retreats, each with an en-suite bathroom and refined finishes. For younger guests, the cozy bunk room provides the ideal setup for shared fun and comfort. Whether enjoying a quiet morning coffee on the porch, lounging poolside, or exploring WaterColor’s scenic trails by bike, every moment at A Slice of Heaven reflects the charm and ease of coastal living.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower, Direct Access to Patio Kitchen Living Room Dining Area Laundry Room Half Bathroom Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Primary Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access Guest Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), En Suite Access to Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bunk Room: Twin-Over-Queen Bunk Bed (sleeps 3), Hallway Access to Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Laundry Area Third Floor Guest Suite: King Bed (sleeps 2), En Suite Access to Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower (updated photos coming soon) Bunk Room: Three Twin Beds (sleeps 3), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Second Living Area Life in WaterColor Located in WaterColor’s desirable Lake District, A Slice of Heaven offers convenient access to the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and nearby Seaside. Spend the day exploring nature trails, relaxing by the pool, or enjoying the area’s dining and shopping, all just minutes from your doorstep.
